name: Whirling Advance damages enemies along its whole path, not only near its end (#7333)
contract: Whirling Advance (500919, 504912-504916) whirls the Barbarian 12 yards forward, "dealing damage to enemies in your
way". Its damage effect targets TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24, a 24-degree cone that is narrow close to the caster,
so an enemy just beside the path 6 yards ahead (18 degrees off the facing) was skipped while the same sideways
offset 11 yards ahead (10 degrees) was hit. The Barbarian stands 2 yards to the side of the line through both
enemies; each is inside the path's width (caster plus target combat reach) and within 12 yards, so both take damage.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the enemy beside the start of the path takes damage
The enemy farther along the path takes damage
